mustFix.title: The remasurement reclassifies qualification observations as leftover fixture design and therefore preserves the wrong remainder
mustFix.claimUnderReview: v5 says OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design because host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view are unauthored, and proposes a later D-000 cycle to author those observation bytes.
primaryEvidence: D-056 decision clause 5 states that authoring fixtures and harness specifications is design work, while execution remains qualification.

The recorded g23-fixture-corpus.v3 authoredCatalog contains the four implementations of every g23-input-corpus.v1 initial state. Its authoredCatalog.executionRemains expressly classifies host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view as G23 execution, not fixture authoring.

g23-fixture-corpus.v3.remainderAfterThisCorpus says a later leftover-join may measure OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING against these authored bytes, then separately says host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view remain qualification. Its empty leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded means that the corpus did not itself perform the join; it is not evidence that the successor join must retain the design remainder.

D-237 records the four fixture implementations, preserves the old v4 standing only until a later leftover remasurement, and again classifies host relation-registry refusal observation and subsequent-session view as qualification.

v5 is that expressly deferred post-D-237 remasurement, yet it uses the corpus's non-self-closing field to avoid measuring the authored implementations and moves the execution observations into design authoring.
mustFix.impact: The artifact's central output is a leftover-design partition. Keeping OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING open for evidence that the pinned authorities classify as execution makes that partition false, prevents the D-056 execution-only remainder from being measured honestly, and invites a later cycle to fabricate or pre-author observation bytes that are supposed to be produced and retained by qualification. Closing the fixture-authoring remainder would not SATISFY DR-133, open Class A, execute G23, or claim QUALIFIED; those boundaries remain separate.
mustFix.requiredRemedy: Remeasure OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING against the four D-237-recorded implementations without counting host-refusal or subsequent-session observations as design authoring. On the pinned record, move those observations exclusively to OBL-G23-EXECUTION/qualification and update the leftover-design partition accordingly. If some additional design artifact truly remains, identify that artifact from an authoritative source and distinguish it from the execution-only observation and subsequent-session evidence. Preserve DR-133 OPEN, Class A unopened, G23 unexecuted, and no implementation authorization.

decision: REJECT — 1 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX. Custody, live HEAD D-237, required-now 28, file-08 pin, frozen-v4 lineage, all recorded inputs, and the no-SATISFIED/no-Class-A/no-implementation boundaries pass. The core post-D-237 remasurement does not: corpus v3 and D-237 classify host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view as later G23 execution/qualification, but v5 makes their absence the reason OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING remains design and proposes authoring those observations in a later D-000 cycle. The empty self-closure field on corpus v3 only says the corpus did not perform its own leftover join; that corpus expressly deferred measurement against its four authored input implementations to this later join. Separately, registerRowNote still says this join measures OBL-G23-HARNESS-SPEC even though the subject marks that obligation non-leftover. Correcting the design/execution partition does not SATISFY DR-133, execute G23, open Class A, or authorize implementation.
